figures.legende: Figure 1 : graphe vitesse-temps (v en m/s, t en s) : v = 5 de t = 0 a t = 7, puis decroissance lineaire jusqu'a 0 en t = 9.

questions.enonce_markdown:
![fig-1](gce-ol-maths-2019-p2-officiel-cameroun_exercice_5_fig_1.png)

Figure 1 is a $(v\text{-}t)$ graph where the distance covered by a moving object is the area under the graph. Calculate the distance covered in $9\,\mathrm{s}$. *[5 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
Read the graph: the velocity is constant at $5\,\mathrm{m/s}$ from $t = 0$ to $t = 7\,\mathrm{s}$, then decreases uniformly to $0$ at $t = 9\,\mathrm{s}$. The area under the graph is a rectangle followed by a triangle.

Rectangle ($0 \le t \le 7$): $7 \times 5 = 35$.

Triangle ($7 \le t \le 9$): $\dfrac{1}{2} \times (9-7) \times 5 = 5$.

Distance $= 35 + 5 = 40\,\mathrm{m}$.

(Equivalently, trapezium: $\frac{1}{2}(9 + 7) \times 5 = 40$.)

**Answer: $40\,\mathrm{m}$.**
